summary: Primary-source review since 2026-11-16 found no newly verified material AI-specific employment evidence changing Career Radar. BLS October payroll release (Nov 6), OECD skill-shortage research (Oct 14), and ILO Viet Nam AI exposure communication (Nov 2) were already assessed. Aggregate payrolls are observed employment but not AI causal evidence; job postings, exposure, adoption, forecasts and surveys must not be treated as realized displacement. No prior evidence duplicated.
